processingOrder.description: This is the order this authorization handler will be processed. If 0, this handler is not active.
processingOrder.label: Processing Order

properties.description: Live object with selected conf properties plus runtime properties for this handler. Valid while the handler remains active; not deep-copied on get.
properties.label: Properties

referenceCount.description: Active instance reference count, copied under authorization_handler_id_anchor_rw_lock (valueAccessor authorization_handler_reference_count). Safe scalar snapshot for admin/debug.
referenceCount.label: Reference Count

serviceId.brief: The id of the associated service
serviceId.description: The id of the associated service. The URI of the service is '/afw/_AdaptiveService_/' followed by this id.
serviceId.label: Service Id

stopping.description: Reference counts of stopping instances, snapshotted under authorization_handler_id_anchor_rw_lock (valueAccessor stopping_authorization_handler_instances).
stopping.label: Stopping Instances
